headline: Tesla Shares Fall as Regulatory and Political Concerns Weigh on Market
summary: Tesla and SpaceX experienced a combined $450 billion two-day market wipeout as investors worried a divided Washington could impact operations.
why: Tesla is a major publicly traded electric vehicle manufacturer whose valuation is sensitive to federal policy, regulatory environments, and market sentiment regarding key leadership.

impacts.name: Tesla, Inc.
impacts.why: Shares dropped amid broader investor worries that political developments in Washington could negatively impact company prospects.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Concerns over a divided Washington and political developments triggered a sharp selloff in companies associated with Elon Musk.
